title: Bou's Second Run

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Hi. Can’t talk now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hi. Can’t talk now.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: It’s frappy hour. Everyone and their uncle wants iced drinks. I’m in a sugary hell-storm of ice and stress.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It’s frappy hour. Everyone and their uncle wants iced drinks. I’m in a sugary hell-storm of ice and stress.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Ha ha. Don’t make me give you decaf.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha ha. Don’t make me give you decaf.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: What? Just… give me a second, yeah? Our delivery droid's still a no-show, and unlike him, I only have two hands.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? Just… give me a second, yeah? Our delivery droid's still a no-show, and unlike him, I only have two hands.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: What? Oh that’s right. Just… give me a second, ok? Thank you SO much for that, by the way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? Oh that’s right. Just… give me a second, ok? Thank you SO much for that, by the way.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Ha! Hardly. Morton's still a no-show and unlike him, I only have two hands.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha! Hardly. Morton's still a no-show and unlike him, I only have two hands.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Oh CORA, I was hoping you’d say that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh CORA, I was hoping you’d say that.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Really? Are you offering? Because the answer is triple-shot yes with extra eternal gratitude.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? Are you offering? Because the answer is triple-shot yes with extra eternal gratitude.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Mhmm. Here's your coffee, valued customer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mhmm. Here's your coffee, valued customer.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: I get it, business never sleeps, huh? Speaking of which, here's your free coffee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get it, business never sleeps, huh? Speaking of which, here's your free coffee.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Let's see, I got a pancake nitro drip with bacon syrup. A nine pump butterscotch mocha with ketchup cream. An extra extra tall grande latte with double whipped cream and sprinkles. And a dark roast filter with a tuna fish croissant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's see, I got a pancake nitro drip with bacon syrup. A nine pump butterscotch mocha with ketchup cream. An extra extra tall grande latte with double whipped cream and sprinkles. And a dark roast filter with a tuna fish croissant.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Eh, you can tell a lot about someone from their coffee order.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, you can tell a lot about someone from their coffee order.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Like... pancake nitro drip with bacon syrup? That might be someone who loves breakfast but doesn't like eating it alone. My bet is they’re sorta lonely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like... pancake nitro drip with bacon syrup? That might be someone who loves breakfast but doesn't like eating it alone. My bet is they’re sorta lonely.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Butterscotch mocha with ketchup cream? Psychopath.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Butterscotch mocha with ketchup cream? Psychopath.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Mmhmm. And the grande latte… no idea on that, except for that’s a TALL coffee. Like, knee-high tall.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mmhmm. And the grande latte… no idea on that, except for that’s a TALL coffee. Like, knee-high tall.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Not sure. Coffee purist, maybe. But unpredictable. Mysterious.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not sure. Coffee purist, maybe. But unpredictable. Mysterious.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: Lifesaver!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lifesaver!

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: You do you, I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You do you, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Bou Friday
nodes.text: No customer name, just says "a gift" here. Well, we get all sorts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No customer name, just says "a gift" here. Well, we get all sorts.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I delivered your coffees. Where’s my free drink?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I delivered your coffees. Where’s my free drink?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I delivered your coffees. Where’s my free drink?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I delivered your coffees. Where’s my free drink?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So if I wanted a lime cheesecake frappe...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So if I wanted a lime cheesecake frappe...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So if I wanted a lime cheesecake frappe...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So if I wanted a lime cheesecake frappe...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seriously though, I would like a coffee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seriously though, I would like a coffee.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Seriously though, I would like a coffee.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Seriously though, I would like a coffee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Deliveries back to normal now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Deliveries back to normal now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Need an extra pair?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Need an extra pair?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just can't get the staff, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just can't get the staff, huh?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just can't get the staff, huh?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just can't get the staff, huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, I don't have time to help today.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, I don't have time to help today.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry, I don't have time to help today.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry, I don't have time to help today.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No problem. What’s on the menu today?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No problem. What’s on the menu today?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No problem. What’s on the menu today?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No problem. What’s on the menu today?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait, that last one - who’s it for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, that last one - who’s it for?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wait, that last one - who’s it for?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wait, that last one - who’s it for?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: These orders are kinda weird.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: These orders are kinda weird.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about the others?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about the others?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think so?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And the dark roast tuna fish combo?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And the dark roast tuna fish combo?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And the dark roast tuna fish combo?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And the dark roast tuna fish combo?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, I'll get these coffees out in no time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I'll get these coffees out in no time.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, I'll get these coffees out in no time.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, I'll get these coffees out in no time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think it sounds good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think it sounds good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm on the way!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm on the way!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can help you again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can help you again.
